name: Body scan

cues.text: Sit or lie down. You can keep your eyes open or closed.
Bring your attention to your feet. Notice whatever is there.
Move your attention up through your legs.
Notice your hips, belly and lower back.
Notice your chest, upper back and shoulders.
Move down your arms to your hands.
Notice your neck, face and head.
Now notice your whole body at once.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel distressed or uneasy.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Move your attention slowly through your body and notice what you find.
copy.end: Wiggle your fingers and toes, and take your time before you get up.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Moderate is for a small effect on self-reported mindfulness only (Gan 2022); weak for any health outcome. Research gives no breath pacing; the default rate is an ambient, unguided visual only. Body-part cue timings are a team choice. Verify before release.
